name: San Bartolomé de Pinares (Spain)
description: Sky blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Bartolomé de Pinares (pines and a knife on white and red).
history: The arms were approved officially on 5 April 1991 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 70 of 12 April 1991), which also describes the flag as a square flag, entirely sky blue, with the arms of the municipality at the centre in proportion 1:2.

features.role: San Bartolomé de Pinares arms — pines and knife
